explanation: Genoa had handed Corsica to France only the year before his birth in 1769. He grew up speaking Corsican, and his first exile, in 1814, was to nearby Elba.

Genoa ceded Corsica to France in 1768, the year before Napoleon's birth.
Napoleon's first exile, in 1814, was to the island of Elba, not far from Corsica.
